# blink

> Send text or JSON state with typed questions. Each question gets a probability for every offered option from one forward pass. No generated text.

Use blink for yes/no (`noul`), choice, and ordered score questions. Probabilities are over the offered options only, not certified chances of being right. Point a TypeSafe SDK or plain HTTP client at the server, or use `gradio_client` for the Space.

Screenshots are opt-in on self-hosted v1.3 or later; see the [API example](https://thegovind.github.io/blink/api.md#screenshots-servepy-only-opt-in).

## Docs

- [API](https://thegovind.github.io/blink/api.md): Send requests and read responses.
- [Agent experience](https://thegovind.github.io/blink/agents.md): Install the skill and find agent-ready docs.
- [Models](https://thegovind.github.io/blink/models.md): Pick a model and open its card.
- [Computer use](https://thegovind.github.io/blink/computer-use.md): Try Screen click, set up screenshots and connect browser agents.
- [Computer-use scenarios](https://thegovind.github.io/blink/computer-use.md#scenarios): Results over ten apps, per-app tables and videos.
- [Runnable CUA examples](https://github.com/thegovind/blink/tree/main/examples/cua): Offline apps, harness, tests and setup.
- [Run on a Mac with MLX](https://github.com/thegovind/blink/tree/main/examples/mlx): Text decisions on Apple silicon, no server.
